title: Compatibility facade route registry
description: Structural schema for compatibility/facade-routes.v1.json: the frozen module-level route registry pairing legacy omnivia_memory modules with their canonical omnivia_core counterparts. This schema checks shape, types, enums and object-level uniqueness only. Cross-field invariants (suffix agreement, count agreement, root uniqueness, state/shape/kind consistency, route ordering, parent/child topology, and checkout drift) are enforced by baseline/facade_manifest.py.

format_version.description: Registry format version. Bump when the on-disk shape changes.

legacy_package.description: Import package that keeps serving deprecated import paths.

canonical_package.description: Import package that owns the canonical implementations.

compatibility_dependency.description: Bounded requirement the legacy distribution declares on the canonical one for its facades to resolve.

expected_counts.description: Pinned partition sizes. Any drift in the routes array fails the loader.

routes.description: One entry per module suffix shared by both package trees, plus the package root. Ordered by legacy_module ascending.

runtime_only_modules.description: Fully qualified legacy modules with no canonical counterpart. Deliberately not routed at this checkpoint.

legacy_module.description: Deprecated import path callers may still use.

canonical_module.description: Canonical import path the legacy path routes to. Shares the legacy path's suffix.

pair_kind.description: direct: nothing in the legacy module's own exported surface blocks conversion -- a runtime-only descendant does not count, so control_plane stays direct despite control_plane.registry. hybrid_barrel: a barrel whose own exported surface mixes portable canonical exports with runtime-owned ones. root: the package root itself.

shape.description: leaf: a plain module. barrel: a package __init__ re-exporting its subtree. root: the package root __init__.

migration_state.description: source_parity: still a duplicated copy, symbol for symbol. canonical_subset: still a duplicated copy but a strict superset of the canonical module, because canonical Core deliberately omits runtime-owned symbols. direct_facade: re-exports canonical objects itself. split_facade: imports its whole portable namespace from its exact canonical counterpart while retaining explicitly tested, legacy-owned synchronous function definitions Core deliberately excludes. transitive_facade: identity-preserving purely through converted children. hybrid_facade: a source-unchanged hybrid barrel whose portable bindings resolve transitively through converted routed children to exact canonical objects while its remaining bindings stay the exact legacy objects imported from descendant modules declared in runtime_only_modules; converted for compatibility accounting without moving runtime code into Core. pending_*: not yet converted.
